mainText: Hello, Verona! At 1 PM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 67 degrees at Verona Area High School under clear skies with a Waxing Gibbous moon. Tonight at 5:49 PM, you can spot the ISS rising in the northwest near Verona High School before it travels toward the northeast near Home Depot, remaining low near the horizon.

The City of Verona has several updates, including the holiday closure of city buildings and the recycling center on November 26 and 27, with trash pickup delayed until Friday. Additionally, the city is moving forward with infrastructure projects, including the Mark Drive reconstruction and intersection improvements at Legion Street, to accommodate our growing population.

There is plenty to do in town! Catch live music at Bailey's Run and Paddy Mac's today. Tomorrow, you can enjoy more music at Wisconsin Brewing Company, and on November 23, visit Insight Wellness for a yoga session.
In a noteworthy call from November 6, officers responded to a business on West Verona Avenue where a woman was found unresponsive in her vehicle. The driver was later arrested for O W I.
Today's flavor of the day is the delightful Crazy for Cookie Dough. The store is currently open and will be serving up scoops until 10:30 PM tonight.
